For three pairwise Type-A words, the three edge intervals have at each differing coordinate exactly two covering intervals, forcing one long edge interval partitioned into two adjacent length≥2 short intervals. The unique vertex shared by short edges is the claimed pivot; equal junction symbol is necessary for the other two vertices to be opposite alternating phases across the long union. An unordered letter pair plus choice of one of two alternating phase splices gives q(q−1); there are n−L+1 placements, L−3 interior cuts, and q^{n−L} contexts. Hence the formula and rational generating function. Independently enumerated all distinct deletion descendant sets and triangles for (q,n)=(2,4),(2,5),(2,6),(3,4), obtaining 2,12,46,6 respectively; all matched formula. Prior 2026-11-02 complete proof independently corroborates unrestricted interval geometry, rather than finite checks alone.
